I’ll check how trace deletion parses IDs, apply the whitespace fix, and add a focused regression test. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill.
The existing staged regression test reproduces the bug. I’ll extend it to cover leading and trailing whitespace as well. The test runner also hit a sandbox permission error in its process-reporting hook after the tests finished.
Updated trace deletion to strip leading and trailing whitespace from each comma-separated ID, so `"a, b"` behaves like `"a,b"`.

Extended the existing regression test to cover spaces, tabs, and newlines. All 12 tests in `tests/cli/test_traces.py` passed using `--no-summary` to avoid a sandbox-restricted reporting hook. No dependencies were installed.

--- a/mlflow/cli/traces.py
+++ b/mlflow/cli/traces.py
@@ -462,7 +462,7 @@ def delete_traces(
     mlflow traces delete --experiment-id 1 --max-timestamp-millis 1700000000000 --max-traces 100
     """
     client = TracingClient()
-    trace_id_list = trace_ids.split(",") if trace_ids else None
+    trace_id_list = [tid.strip() for tid in trace_ids.split(",")] if trace_ids else None
 
     count = client.delete_traces(

diff --git a/tests/cli/test_traces.py b/tests/cli/test_traces.py
index bcc88ec50..b37576b7c 100644
--- a/tests/cli/test_traces.py
+++ b/tests/cli/test_traces.py
@@ -158,6 +158,20 @@ def test_delete_command(runner):
         assert "Deleted 5 trace(s)" in result.output
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("trace_ids", ["tr-1,tr-2", "tr-1, tr-2", " \ttr-1 \t, \ttr-2 \n"])
+def test_delete_command_strips_spaces_in_trace_ids(runner, trace_ids):
+    with mock.patch("mlflow.cli.traces.TracingClient") as mock_client:
+        mock_client.return_value.delete_traces.return_value = 2
+        result = runner.invoke(
+            commands,
+            ["delete", "--experiment-id", "1", "--trace-ids", trace_ids],
+        )
+
+    assert result.exit_code == 0
+    _, kwargs = mock_client.return_value.delete_traces.call_args
+    assert kwargs["trace_ids"] == ["tr-1", "tr-2"]
+
